item.title: How an Assam startup is rethinking sustainable beauty
item.description: India’s beauty boom is giving way to tougher questions around safety, sustainability, and waste. A young skincare brand from Assam is answering them by upcycling waste into wellness.

item.title: Project Tarasha showcases the magic of design collaborating with art and entrepreneurship
item.description: In this photo essay, we showcase a range of artworks from a unique four-day craft exhibition in Bangalore International Centre.

item.title: Anthropic rolls out upgraded Claude Opus model with improved coding and agentic AI skills
item.description: Claude Opus 4.6 can plan more carefully and sustain agentic tasks for longer periods than its predecessor. It can also operate more reliably in larger codebases and has better code review and debugging skills.

item.title: Veranda Learning Q3 profit soars 110% as 'Veranda 2.0' strategy gains traction
item.description: Veranda Learning reported a net profit of Rs 17 crore, driven by a 52% revenue rise. The company is accelerating its "Veranda 2.0" strategy, focusing on cost efficiency and advancing the demerger of its commerce vertical.

item.title: Why managing your energy matters more than managing time
item.description: Time can be managed, but energy must be protected. Learn why guarding your energy leads to better focus, boundaries, and fulfillment.

item.title: The vanilla ice cream complaint that stumped GM engineers
item.description: A bizarre complaint about vanilla ice cream led GM to uncover a real engineering flaw, revealing why strange feedback deserves serious attention.

item.title: Mahoba: The small diesel workshop farmers rely on when tractors fail
item.description: In Natrada village, near Panwari in Mahoba district, a modest roadside workshop has become a practical stop for farmers and drivers

item.title: Inside Deepflow Technologies’ mission to bring reliable farm intelligence to Indian farmers
item.description: Kannur-based agritech startup Deepflow Technologies offers a unified platform that enables farmers and farmer collectives to manage multiple crops simultaneously, instead of building solutions around a single crop.

item.title: From CRMs to intelligence hubs: How go-to-market is being rebuilt
item.description: In 2026, many GTM leaders are acknowledging a gap between what CRMs were built to do and what modern GTM actually demands.

item.title: IIT Madras Research Park, Unicorn India Ventures launch Rs 600 Cr fund for deeptech startups
item.description: The 'Unicorn Frontier Fund I' targets IP-led robotics and defence startups, offering patient capital to boost domestic tech sovereignty and reduce import reliance.
